items.title: Why autonomous AI agents fail in production
items.raw_excerpt:
Most AI agent demos look impressive. They plan tasks, call tools, self-correct, and complete workflows end-to-end.
But when teams try to deploy them in production — especially where money, safety, or compliance is involved — the same problems appear again and again. Not because the models are inaccurate, but because the system is structurally unsafe. Here are the failure modes I keep seeing: Non-replayable decisions
Agent behavior depends on implicit context, dynamic reasoning, and probabilistic paths.
When something goes wrong, you can’t reliably replay why a decision was made. Probabilistic components with execution authority
Language models generate plausible outputs, not deterministic decisions.
Giving them final execution power creates an unbounded risk surface. No hard veto layer
Man

items.title: 从「工具」到「搭档」，AI4S 走过深水区 | 2025年终回顾
items.raw_excerpt: 在这一轮波澜壮阔的人工智能浪潮中，我们常被算力、模型规模和颠覆式叙事所簇拥。然而，真正值得记录的变化，往往发生在那些远离喧嚣的实验室里、发生在一行行代码与科学假设的碰撞中：AI 是如何从一种“使能技术”，演变为改变人类推进科研的基本范式的？ 2025年，AI4Science（AI4S）不再仅仅是论文中的愿景。它正以一种极其务实且具体的姿态，嵌入到每一位科学家的日常。 在这一年里，我们看到 AI4S 呈现出多维度的进化： 它是高效的“科研加速器”： 从润色论文到整理会议纪要，从自动化数据处理到启发科学假设，正如吴琦教授与许东教授所言，AI 正在将科学家从低效的试错中解放，让他们重新聚焦于“创造性思维”本身。 它是认知的“破局者”： 无论是 AlphaFold 3 的持续震撼，还是 Noetik 的虚拟细胞模型，AI 开始突破传统学科的藩篱。樊隽轩教授与张清鹏教授都观察到，当数据被转化为 AI 可理解的要素，两个独立领域被真正贯通，认知的“红利”正加速转化为科研的“生产力”。 它是未来的“自主探索者”： 尽管如张晓峰教授所指，AI Scientist 尚处初级阶段，但“自动化发现”（Automation）已成为杜沅岂等年轻学者眼中的确定未来。 正如李国杰院士在寄语中所指出：AI4S 正在让思维本身成为可工程化的对象。如果说 2024 年是 AI 获得科学界最高荣誉诺贝尔奖的加冕礼，那么 2025 年则是 AI 深入科研的“现场记录”。 步入 2026 年，我们不仅关注模型能力的突破，更期待“AI 专家”与“学科专家”的深度共融，期待鄂维南院士所构想的“超级实验室”与开源共享生态的落地。 为此，雷峰网邀请了来自顶级高校及一线科研机构的多位AI 专家与学科专家，通过他们的亲历与洞察，还原一个真实、诚恳且充满可能性的 AI4S 2025。这不仅是一次年度总结，更是一份通往“

excerpt_i18n.en: From the closed sections of factories and mining areas to the more open world, autonomous driving technology faces multiple challenges from real traffic environments. Vehicles changing lanes and overtaking, suddenly opened car doors, pedestrians crossing the street... While autonomous driving systems learn to perform 4D modeling, reconstruction, and resimulation of these dynamic objects, most solutions still rely on per-scene optimization, known camera calibration, or short-frame windows, making them slow and impractical. The ability to quickly and cost-effectively obtain simulation data in dynamic driving scenarios determines the evolution speed of autonomous driving systems in the open world. Against this backdrop, Professor Zhao Hao's team, with long-term expertise in neural rendering and simulation technology, has proposed the first pose-free feedforward 3D reconstruction framework for large-scale dynamic driving scenes—DGGT (Driving Gaussian Grounded Transformer). Zhao Hao is currently an assistant professor at the Institute for AI Industry Research (AIR) at Tsinghua University and a BAAI Scholar. His research focuses on the field of computer vision, with years of in-depth work in 3D scene understanding, generative simulation, and neural rendering. His research findings hold significant importance for autonomous driving and embodied intelligence simulation. Notably, Professor Zhao Hao will attend the 2025 GAIR Global Artificial Intelligence and Robotics Conference as the organizing committee chair and host the World Models sub-forum, sharing his latest explorations in world models. excerpt_i18n.en:
Skyris was originally inspired by a guinea pig named Tuntun. It was the most homebody pet Zhang Yunuo ever had, spending its days lying among a group of young entrepreneurs, rarely moving, quietly accepting praise and petting. At the time, Zhang Yunuo was working on delivery drones in the U.S. when a friend suddenly asked him, why can’t guinea pigs fly? Tuntun never took flight, but the combination of flight and pets perfectly aligned the two pieces of Skyris. Or perhaps Zhang Yunuo had always wanted to focus on pets; the voice box is as homebound as a guinea pig, and flight merely gives them the ability to actively provide companionship, much like what Zhang Yunuo felt from his other pets.  

Zhang Yunuo has kept many pets: five dogs, three cats, a snake, a guinea pig, and soon, a parrot. The story began when he was five years old, when a Tibetan Mastiff almost as tall as himself became his companion. At the time, Zhang Yunuo was still afraid of dogs. He ran, and it chased, until his legs could no longer move, and “being eaten” seemed like an option. Zhang Yunuo lay on the ground, giving up. But the Tibetan Mastiff just trotted over with its large head, looked at him, and then lowered its head to lick his face.

items.raw_excerpt: 12月12日，第八届GAIR全球人工智能与机器人大会在深圳正式启幕。 本次大会为期两天，由GAIR研究院与雷峰网联合主办，高文院士任指导委员会主席，杨强院士与朱晓蕊教授任大会主席。 作为观测AI技术演进与生态变迁的重要窗口，GAIR大会自2016年创办以来以来，始终与全球AI发展的脉搏同频共振，见证了技术浪潮从实验室涌向产业深海。2025年，是大模型从“技术破壁”迈向“价值深耕”的关键节点，值此之际GAIR如期而至，携手智者触摸AI最前沿脉动，洞见产业深层逻辑。 大会上，之江实验室科学模型总体组技术总师，天壤智能CEO薛贵荣博士亲临现场，为参会者带来了一场精彩纷呈的演讲分享。 薛贵荣博士指出，以大语言模型为代表的AI技术虽已在多个学科研究中展现出潜力，但其本质上仍受限于“语言的边界”，难以真正理解高维度、多类型的科学数据，更无法独立完成可验证的科学发现。 基于此，薛贵荣博士系统分析了大语言模型与科学基础模型之间的本质差异，并详细阐述了之江实验室所研发出的021科学基础模型在突破语言维度、统一化科学数据、科学推理与发现，跨学科知识融合等方面的关键优势。同时，他提出一些关于面向“AI+科学”新范式的思考： 1、大语言模型在解决科学问题上还存在很大的局限，在覆盖100多个学科的高难度HLE测试中，表现最优的模型目前也只达到了25.4%的准确率。 2、要想解决科学问题，大科学基础模型的需要超越语言空间，做到真正理解化学、天文学、地球科学、生命科学、材料科学等各类科学知识。 3、科学基础模型与当前的大语言模型之间的主要差别是，大语言模型以文本数据作为Token化的基础，而科学基础模型所对应表达的Token是跨学科、多类型的科学数据。 4、要想把科学数据Token化得先解决OneTokenizer的问题，就是把光谱、化学结构、DNA数据等结构化之后统一到一个高维空间中。 5、将科学数据

excerpt_i18n.en: On December 12, the eighth GAIR Global Artificial Intelligence and Robotics Summit officially commenced in Shenzhen. The two-day event was jointly organized by the GAIR Institute and Leiphone, with Academician Gao Wen serving as the chair of the steering committee, and Academician Yang Qiang and Professor Zhu Xiaorui as conference chairs. As a key window for observing the evolution of AI technology and ecosystem changes, the GAIR Summit has resonated with the pulse of global AI development since its inception in 2016, witnessing technological waves surge from laboratories into the depths of industry. In 2025, a critical juncture where large models transition from "technological breakthroughs" to "value deepening," GAIR arrived as scheduled, joining hands with experts to explore the forefront of AI and gain insights into the underlying logic of the industry. At the summit, Dr. Xue Guirong, Chief Technology Officer of the Scientific Model Group at the Zhejiang Laboratory and CEO of Tianrang Intelligence, delivered an engaging presentation. Dr. Xue pointed out that while AI technologies, represented by large language models, have shown potential in multiple disciplines, they remain inherently constrained by the "boundaries of language," struggling to truly understand high-dimensional, diverse scientific data and independently achieve verifiable scientific discoveries. Based on this, Dr. Xue systematically analyzed the fundamental differences between large language models and scientific foundation models, detailing the key advantages of the 021 scientific foundation model developed by the Zhejiang Laboratory in breaking through language dimensions, unifying scientific data, enabling scientific reasoning and discovery, and integrating interdisciplinary knowledge. He also proposed several perspectives on advancing "AI + Science."
excerpt_i18n.es: El 12 de diciembre, se inauguró oficialmente en Shenzhen la octava edición de la Conferencia Global de Inteligencia Artificial y Robótica (GAIR). Este evento de dos días está organizado conjuntamente por el Instituto GAIR y Leiphone, con el académico Gao Wen como presidente del comité directivo, y los académicos Yang Qiang y la profesora Zhu Xiaorui como copresidentes de la conferencia. Como una ventana clave para observar la evolución tecnológica y los cambios en el ecosistema de la IA, la conferencia GAIR ha estado en sintonía con el pulso del desarrollo global de la IA desde su creación en 2016, presenciando cómo las olas tecnológicas pasaron del laboratorio a la industria. En 2025, un año crucial en el que los grandes modelos transitan de "romper barreras técnicas" a "profundizar en el valor", GAIR llega puntualmente, uniendo a expertos para explorar las fronteras más avanzadas de la IA.

excerpt_i18n.en: Leifeng.com exclusively learned that AI coding startup AIGCode recently completed consecutive rounds of financing led by Bohua Capital and Lihe Capital respectively, with Lihe Financial and multiple industrial capital investors participating. Founded in January 2024, the company did not follow the trend of Copilot-like products but decided from Day 1 to directly develop an end-to-end Autopilot product. AIGCode's founder and CEO, Dr. Su Wen, graduated from Tsinghua University with an engineering degree, is a serial entrepreneur, and previously served as a DeepTech investor at a top-tier Chinese VC. Co-founder and CTO Chen Qiuwu worked at leading internet companies such as Microsoft, Tencent, and Baidu for 16 years, leading AI teams for 11 years, and participated in GPT model implementation projects at Microsoft as early as 2018. AIGCode primarily focuses on Vibe Coding product development. In May this year, its first Autopilot product, AutoCoder.cc, began internal testing in China, followed by a global public beta in July. excerpt_i18n.en: Over the past two years, the surge in embodied intelligence has been driven by a shared anticipation: the remarkable capabilities of large language models are widely recognized, and integrating them into robots holds the promise of endowing robots with smarter brains, thereby opening new horizons for the industry. However, after two years of fervor, embodied intelligence still lacks a standard solution, yet many specialized subfields have emerged, with intelligent aerial robots being a significant branch. Gao Fei, a tenured associate professor and doctoral supervisor at the College of Control Science and Engineering, Zhejiang University, is an outstanding young scholar in this field. His research focuses include aerial robotics, autonomous navigation, swarm coordination, and embodied intelligence. He proposed the world's first autonomous flight swarm system for unstructured environments, published multiple papers in top-tier journals and conferences such as Science Robotics and TRO, and founded Differential Intelligence Flight. Gao Fei is a recipient of the National Excellent Young Scientists Fund, has received multiple best paper nominations from IEEE TRO and IROS, and was named to the 2023-2024 global top 2% of scientists and the 2025 MIT Technology Review "35 Innovators Under 35" (MIT TR35) Asia Pacific list. At the recently concluded GAIR 2025, Professor Gao Fei delivered a presentation titled "Research Progress and Industrial Applications of Intelligent Aerial Robots" at the GAIR conference hosted by Leiphone. His presentation style was highly vivid: he used drone formation scenes from "Prometheus" to introduce the ultimate form of "distributed swarms," and contrasted chaotic scenes from "The Wandering Earth" to emphasize "decentralization."
excerpt_i18n.es: En los últimos dos años, el auge de la inteligencia encarnada se debe a una expectativa común: las destacadas capacidades de los grandes modelos de lenguaje son evidentes, y si se integran en robots, podrían dotarlos de cerebros más inteligentes, abriendo así nuevos horizontes para la industria. Sin embargo, tras dos años de fervor, la inteligencia encarnada aún no tiene una respuesta estándar, pero han surgido muchas áreas especializadas, siendo los robots voladores inteligentes una rama importante. Gao Fei, profesor asociado de planta y tutor de doctorado en la Facultad de Control de la Universidad de Zhejiang, es un destacado joven académico en este campo. Sus principales líneas de investigación incluyen robots aéreos, navegación autónoma, coordinación de enjambres e inteligencia encarnada, habiendo propuesto el primer sistema de enjambre de vuelo autónomo en entornos no estructurados a nivel internacional y publicado múltiples trabajos.

excerpt_i18n.zh: 作者丨齐铖湧 编辑丨马晓宁 世界模型的研究尚处于起步阶段，共识尚未形成，有关该领域的研究形成了无数支流，过去一年多，Sora为代表的视频生成模型，成为继大语言模型（LLM）后新的学术热点。本质上讲，当下火爆的视频生成模型，是一种世界模型，其核心目的是生成一段逼真、连贯的视频。 要达到这样的目的，模型必须在一定程度上理解这个世界的运作方式（比如水往低处流、物体碰撞后的运动、人的合理动作等）。 胡文博正是世界模型研究领域近两年的绝对新锐。 在刚刚结束的 GAIR 2025，腾讯ARC Lab高级研究员胡文博，在雷峰网举办的GAIR大会现场带来了非常有见解的演讲：《迈向三维感知的视频世界模型》（Towards 3D-aware Video World Models ）。 以下是具体内容，AI科技评论做了不改变原意的编辑和整理。 感谢邀请和介绍，我今天分享的题目是《迈向三维感知的视频世界模型》（Towards 3D-aware Video World Models）。 之所以讲这个，是因为Sora在2024年初出来时，给大家带来很大震撼。比如它生成的视频，虽然看起来是二维的，但已经具备一定的3D一致性。不过从我们做三维重建的角度看，比如尝试把它重建出来，会发现墙面与地面的垂直性、平整度等都还不够好。 基于这个观察，领域内认为视频扩散模型有潜力作为世界模型的一种表示方式，但视频本身仍是二维的，而我们的世界是三维的。 所以我们思考：如何实现一个具备三维感知能力的视频世界模型？ 为了实现这种三维感知，我们主要做了两方面工作，今天重点讲第二方面。 第一方面是如何从二维观测中重建三维信息，这部分和前面彭老师讲的内容比较接近。第二方面是如何将重建得到的三维信息融入到生成过程中，使二维空间的视频扩散模型具备三维感知特性。 我先简单介绍一下第一方面的工作：如何在开放世界环境中，从二维视频中重建三维
excerpt_i18n.en:
Author: Qi Chengyong  Editor: Ma Xiaoning  
Research on world models is still in its early stages, with no consensus yet formed. Studies in this field have branched into countless directions. Over the past year or so, video generation models, represented by Sora, have emerged as a new academic hotspot following large language models (LLMs). Essentially, the currently popular video generation models are a type of world model, with the core goal of generating realistic and coherent videos.  
To achieve this, the models must, to some extent, understand how the world operates (e.g., water flows downhill, the motion of objects after collision, reasonable human actions, etc.).  
Hu Wenbo is precisely the standout newcomer in the field of world model research over the past two years.  
At the recently concluded GAIR 2025, Hu Wenbo, a senior researcher at Tencent ARC Lab, delivered a highly insightful speech titled "Towards 3D-aware Video World Models" at the GAIR conference hosted by Leiphone.  
The following is the detailed content, edited and organized by AI Tech Review without altering the original meaning.  
Thank you for the invitation and introduction. The topic of my presentation today is "Towards 3D-aware Video World Models."  
I chose this topic because when Sora was released in early 2024, it greatly impressed everyone. For instance, the videos it generates, though seemingly two-dimensional, already possess a certain level of 3D...
excerpt_i18n.es: Autor: Qi Chengyong. Editor: Ma Xiaoning. La investigación sobre modelos del mundo aún se encuentra en sus primeras etapas, sin que se haya alcanzado un consenso, y los estudios en este campo han generado innumerables ramificaciones. En el último año, los modelos de generación de vídeo, representados por Sora, se han convertido en un nuevo foco académico tras los grandes modelos de lenguaje (LLM). En esencia, los populares modelos de generación de vídeo actuales son un tipo de modelo del mundo, cuyo objetivo central es producir vídeos realistas y coherentes. Para lograrlo, el modelo debe comprender, hasta cierto punto, cómo funciona el mundo (por ejemplo, que el agua fluye hacia abajo, el movimiento de los objetos tras una colisión o las acciones humanas razonables). Hu Wenbo es precisamente una figura emergente absoluta en el campo de la investigación de modelos del mundo en los últimos dos años.
